wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: Begin at the threshold: one sideways question, about a door, a stone or a mark, opens a puzzle that suits the reading. Or step into any world below.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.what: See where each reading leads, then follow the world it opens onto, or any world card below.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan every page in one pass, with one plain line on what to do first on each.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: Keep a vigil in a dim room: put every lamp out, order the keepsakes from clues, or find which two switches changed the lamps.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Read your own sky: order a postcard's lights by depth from how they shift, or spot which turned sky is yours.

worlds.name: the gravity well
worlds.what: Cast a probe through a ring, order moons by their orbits, or turn a two-moon system to find when its moons meet again.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Keep the watch: recall the stars in flash order, find two false logbook lines, or compare two skies to name a moving star, its direction and its distance.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Read what answers: order stars by when their echoes return, or unmix a changing set of voices by comparing your selection with its beat totals.

worlds.name: the pulse loom
worlds.what: Weave two beats on one loop and count where they cross, or say which way a strobed wheel seems to turn and when it repeats.

worlds.name: the pendulum hall
worlds.what: Keep time with pendulums that start together or on staggered beats: find their shared crossing, or tune a spring to hand a swing across in time.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Light the rite: order lanterns from clues, predict a drift, recover missing winds, or follow mirrored lanterns to their first crossing.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Tend what is under glass: decide which plants get water from their tags and readings, or order the stems by age.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Read the weather maps: try an arrival hour and watch your forecast move, or trace the wind from high pressure to low.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Close the pattern: count the folds of a weave and spot its mirror, or count the bands of a moire to find the hidden screen.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: Learn the automaton's rule, test it in a notebook and write the next rows, or find the one cell that changed.

worlds.name: the light table
worlds.what: Light a lamp on purpose: measure slit spacing, order polarising filters, or match two coloured lamps to a target.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Set the floor in motion: call the domino gaps, find a loaded plank's balance point, or choose and place a hanging counterweight to make it balance.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: Read a soil core, blend two bags of earth for a bed, or follow a root through the layers to its exit.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Fire scrambled letters into a word, or climb a word ladder using a rack of words and decoys; some climbs take an extra step.

worlds.name: the cipher cabinet
worlds.what: Unlock a note: count its commonest letters to crack the wheel that shifted it, or find the route a turning key reads it by.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: File impossible specimens by their clues — some cabinets stand five drawers tall — spot the one that breaks the drawer's rule, or find the forged catalogue number.

worlds.name: the shadow theatre
worlds.what: Work out where the lamp stands from a shadow's size, or match four or six enlarged, leaning shadows to their paper cutouts.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Ask the archive: try turns of a letter wheel until its stars read a word, find two true omens, or trace a star's route and add its light.

finePrint.what: Read exactly what stays in your browser, what cookies can count, and how to take all of it back.

finePrint.name: terms
finePrint.what: Read the plain bargain: play freely, keep what you make, and expect no warranty.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: A wrong turn still lands in the river: a puzzle opens here, with every world below.
